annotations.title: Compare catch-up options for unreported foreign assets

description: For a U.S. taxpayer who missed FBAR or Form 8938 filings or left foreign income unreported, estimates and compares the cost of three catch-up paths: A) delinquent information return procedures (only when no income went unreported), B) amended returns with tax and interest plus a reasonable-cause statement (with the statutory penalty exposure if reasonable cause is rejected), and C) the Streamlined Domestic Offshore Procedures (tax, interest and the 5% penalty). Also adds the 1% Form 720 excise tax on premiums paid to foreign insurers. Tax years 2019–2025. Assumes non-willful conduct; it does not decide eligibility.

filing_status.description: Filing status used on the original returns.

years.description: One entry per affected tax year.

agi.description: Adjusted gross income as originally filed, USD (for the 3.8% net investment income tax).

fbar_filed_complete.description: FBAR for that year was filed on time and listed every account and policy.

foreign_insurance_premiums.description: Premiums paid that year to foreign life insurers or annuity issuers, USD (1% excise tax).

form_8938_filed_complete.description: Form 8938 for that year was filed and complete.

taxable_income.description: Taxable income as originally filed, USD.

unreported_income.description: Income that should have been reported but was not, USD (e.g. foreign interest, dividends, §7702(g) policy growth).

year_end_unreported_foreign_assets.description: Year-end value of foreign assets that were not properly reported, USD (the base for the Streamlined 5% penalty).
